source.title: New estimates for the length of the Erdos-Herzog-Piranian lemniscate
subject: math.CA

questions.topic: What length bound do they prove?
questions.verdict: Three bounds, increasing sharpness, culminating in |L| <= 2n + O(n^{7/8}) asymptotic for all monic p of degree n.

bounds.name: simplest upper bound
bounds.refinement: |L| <= 2*pi*(2k - 1) where k = number of distinct roots
bounds.proof_sketch: Bound |L| by area integral of logarithmic-derivative sum; Polya theorem (Ransford [11], Thm 5.3.5) gives area(E) <= pi since logarithmic capacity of E equals 1.

bounds.name: improved upper bound
bounds.proof_sketch: Reweight extension s = |p|*|phi|/phi; |L| = 2*int|p'| - int(|p*phi|/phi)*psi (eq. 6); Cauchy on int|p'|^2 = pi*n gives int|p'| <= pi*sqrt(n); tail bounded by 2*pi*(n-1).

bounds.name: asymptotic estimate
bounds.form: |L| <= 2n + O(n^{7/8}) as n -> infinity, for all monic polynomials p of degree n
bounds.open_remark_by_authors: Power 7/8 can be substantially improved; bringing below 1/2 is challenging.

questions.auxiliary_result_section_6: |L_p| <= |L_{p_0}| for p sufficiently close to p_0 = z^n - 1; i.e. p_0 is a strict local maximum of |L| in coefficient space. Qualitative; no explicit neighborhood radius.

questions.verdict: Two regimes. Anonymous c_n / C 'depending on n only' in section 5-6 local-max argument. Fully numeric explicit prefactors throughout sections 7-9 asymptotic chain.

anonymous_constants.context: |L_p_tilde intersect D_r| <= 2nr - c_n; c_n > 0 depends on n only.
|G intersect T_rho| <= C*a^2*rho^{-1}; absolute positive constant depending on n only (eq. 5).

explicit_numerics: section 9 Remez application (top of p. 9): 4*2^{1/n}*r^2*int_0^pi d_alpha/|cos(n*alpha)|^{1/n} = C*r^2; the 4*2^{1/n} prefactor is named explicitly.
questions.constants_extractable_to_named_K: Yes. A careful reader can extract a fully numeric K_FN such that |L| <= 2n + K_FN * n^{7/8} for all n >= N_FN_0, where both K_FN and N_FN_0 are computable from the section 9 inequalities. Authors do not collect K_FN explicitly.

questions.verdict: NEUTRAL on Track A4's K_logn(C_0) = K_logn_universal * C_0^4. The paper has no C_0 parameter. Closest analogues are delta and r; neither appears with power 4.
questions.key_finding: Dominant free-parameter power in section 9 is delta^{-3} (cubic, NOT quartic). Optimization delta + 1/(delta^3 * sqrt(n)) yields delta ~ n^{-1/8}.

parameters_present.role: good-set radius defining E_delta via inequalities (7), (8)

parameters_present.definition: a = sum_{k != 0} |a_k|/|k|; Fourier coefficients of Re_+ z on unit circle (eq. 16)
parameters_present.note: Fixed by the function Re_+ z; not user-tunable; cannot play role of Tao's C_0.

parameters_present.role: annulus radius in section 6 first-variation argument only
parameters_present.note: Set to r = a^{2/3} where a = max_k |a_k|^{1/k} is smallness scale; adapted to perturbation, not free.

questions.implication_for_track_a4: Fryntov-Nazarov's text neither confirms nor refutes the C_0^4 claim on its own terms. It DOES refute any narrative that says the C_0^4 factor is inherited from Fryntov-Nazarov. Track A4 must source C_0^4 from elsewhere (likely Tao 2512.12455 internal accounting) or restate the claim.

questions.verdict: Shared technique family (Stokes / Cauchy / area-integral) but different decomposition surgery. Constants do not transfer cleanly.
shared_with_tao: Stokes formula: |L| = 2 Re int_E partial-s dA (Fryntov-Nazarov eq. 4)
Logarithmic derivative phi = p'/p with pole-at-roots decomposition: 2 partial-s = (|phi|/phi)*(sum_eta 1/(z-eta) - sum_zeta 1/(z-zeta))
Cauchy / Holder on int|p'|^k dA (e.g. int|p'|^2 = pi*n exact identity)
different_from_tao: Fryntov-Nazarov uses good-set E_delta + bad-set tubes + Polya capacity cover F (squares of side delta^2/sqrt(n)). Single scalar delta in (0, 1/4).
No inside / annulus / outside trichotomy in the asymptotic argument (section 9). The closest radial split is in section 6's first-variation argument near p_0, not the asymptotic estimate.
Auxiliary tools unique to Fryntov-Nazarov: Poincare central-projection on sphere of radius R -> infinity (section 5, pp. 5-6); Remez theorem from Borwein-Erdelyi [12] Thm 5.1.1 (top of p. 9).
Tao's C_0-parametrized annulus accounting is absent. No free large parameter is used to control an outer radial shell.
questions.implication: Constants extracted from Fryntov-Nazarov's delta-optimization will not transfer term-for-term to Tao's C_0-parametrized accounting. Any bridge between the two must be reconstructed, not invoked.

questions.topic: Claim ceiling and relation to predecessors / Tao
questions.verdict: Section 9 is asymptotic for all n; resolves no new finite-n cases. Section 6 local-max is qualitative.

predecessor_chain.result: Original conjecture |L_p| <= |L_{p_0}| = 2n + O(1); listed as Problem 12.
Proved EHP for n=2; all critical points of extremal p lie on L_p; |L| <= 9.173*n for all n.
|L| <= 2*pi*n; best published upper bound at time of writing.
|L| <= 2n + O(n^{7/8}); first sub-leading remainder; |L_p| <= |L_{p_0}| qualitatively near p_0.

questions.finite_n_cases_resolved_by_paper: None. Only n=2 has been resolved (Eremenko-Hayman 1999).
questions.relation_to_tao_2512_12455: Tao's large-n result sits downstream of Fryntov-Nazarov in the same asymptotic-improvement lineage. Both improve the o(n) remainder. Neither is a finite-n resolution.

track_a4_c0_to_4th_power_claim.explanation: Fryntov-Nazarov has no C_0 and no power-4 free parameter anywhere in the bound. Track A4 cannot cite Fryntov-Nazarov as the prior-art warrant for C_0^4. If the C_0^4 power is correct, it must come from Tao 2512.12455 internal accounting or fresh derivation, not from Fryntov-Nazarov.
track_a4_c0_to_4th_power_claim.honest_label: The C_0^4 claim survives only if independently warranted. The Perplexity flag was correct to surface this paper, but the paper itself does not contradict the value of the power; it contradicts the attribution.

bridge_program_n0_target.soft_threshold: delta = n^{-1/8} requires delta < 1/4, i.e. n > 4^8 = 65,536, for the section 9 OPTIMIZATION to be in range. Pre-optimized form valid for all n.
bridge_program_n0_target.implication_for_bridge_at_small_n: Bridge program operates at n <= 14, far below 6.5e4 threshold. Fryntov-Nazarov is structural / methodological reference, not a numerical N_0 constraint.

implications.acknowledgment_paragraph_for_future_prep: The decomposition strategy used here builds on the Stokes-formula framework introduced for the Erdos-Herzog-Piranian lemniscate by Fryntov and Nazarov (arXiv:0808.0717, 2008), who proved |L| <= 2n + O(n^{7/8}) asymptotically and showed that p_0(z) = z^n - 1 is a local maximum of the lemniscate length in coefficient space. We use a different parameter trichotomy than their good-set / bad-set / capacity-cover surgery, and our parameter dependence does not match theirs term-for-term, but the underlying analytic primitives (Stokes reduction |L| = 2 Re int_E partial-s dA, logarithmic-derivative pole decomposition, area-integral Cauchy on |p'|) are theirs. Their o(n) bound was the first sub-leading remainder for the EHP problem and remained the best published asymptotic estimate prior to Tao (2512.12455).
